name: corridor
short: Shared reply style and permission tiers for office-cogs.
description: Owns one guild-wide store for reply formatting (text/embed, icon) and moderator/privileged role tiers, plus the one shared LLM connection every LLM-backed dependent (pico, architect) uses, plus the one shared A2A listener every registered agent is mounted on (see docs/agent-directory-design.md), plus an MCP client bridging any registered agent-tool server (suggestionbox) into a registered A2A agent's own tool loop (see docs/suggestionbox-design.md), exposed to other cogs via required_cogs so they don't each reinvent it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users. It stores a bot-owner-configured LLM endpoint, model, and virtual key used by dependent cogs, plus the bind host/port for its own shared A2A listener.
author: Tin Nguyen
